title: Octal bus transceiver with 3-state outputs

sources.document: TI SN54LS245/SN74LS245 datasheet SDLS146B (October 1976, revised September 2016)

pins.name: DIR
pins.text: direction: low = B to A, high = A to B

pins.name: A1
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B1) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A2
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B2) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A3
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B3) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A4
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B4) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A5
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B5) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A6
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B6) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A7
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B7) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: A8
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B8) when DIR is low and OE is low

pins.name: B8
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A8) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B7
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A7) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B6
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A6) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B5
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A5) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B4
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A4) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B3
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A3) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B2
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A2) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: B1
pins.text: bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A1) when DIR is high and OE is low

pins.name: OE
pins.text: output enable; high = all channels disabled (high impedance), the buses are isolated

functions.text: A1 drives B1 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B1 drives A1 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A2 drives B2 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B2 drives A2 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A3 drives B3 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B3 drives A3 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A4 drives B4 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B4 drives A4 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A5 drives B5 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B5 drives A5 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A6 drives B6 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B6 drives A6 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A7 drives B7 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B7 drives A7 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.
A8 drives B8 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance.
B8 drives A8 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance.

electrical.notes: SN74LS245 figures (pages 3-5). A and B inputs have hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ (page 5); thresholds not given. Off-state current 20 uA high, -200 uA low.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF

VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 5 pF

unknown: The switching table (page 5) does not name the from/to pins; port to port for tPLH/tPHL and OE for the enable/disable times are taken from what those times mean.
The datasheet gives no delay for a change of DIR alone.
vtPlusV and vtMinusV: only the hysteresis is given.
notes: A and B pins are both inputs and outputs; they are listed with role output (three-state) as the 8553 file does. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS245.
